Intel designs and manufactures silicon products that enable digital experiences and connected devices. The Software Engineer – Datacenter role develops, tests, debugs, and maintains secure, scalable software applications across frontend and backend systems, while collaborating with cross-functional teams and end-users to deliver effective solutions.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and debug software applications for end-users or integrated with third-party applications
Contribute to both frontend and backend development using modern software methodologies and programming languages
Write functional and test code, automate build and deployment processes, and perform unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
Follow secure coding practices and ensure compliance with software legal guidelines
Analyze user stories to translate requirements into practical software solutions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient infrastructure planning and functionality
Complete product documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance
Interact with end-users to define system requirements and implement necessary modifications

Required

US Citizenship required
Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Security Clearance
Proficiency in scripting languages like Python or Perl
Familiarity with Linux shells and command-line interfaces (CLI)
Preferred
Experience with industry-standard tools such as Ansible, Cobbler, Containers, and Kubernetes
Knowledge of Linux operating systems (preferably SUSE)
Exposure to continuous monitoring solutions like Elastic, Kibana, and Grafana
Basic understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, and HTTP/S
Familiarity with static typed programming languages such as Java or C++
